authoring.method: Complete image_gen drawings; crop, hard-alpha extraction, one uniform scale per master strip, and foot registration translations only. No procedural body or limb warping.
authoring.historical_attempt_status: Retained authoring evidence only; no pose or clip consumes these superseded drawings.
authoring.hand_annotations: Visible distal hand/finger contact pixels on new side drawings; back-facing grip trajectory is authored intent behind the torso. Small natural gaps are recorded without stretching anatomy.
authoring.phase_order: Operating source cell order is not assumed to match crank angle. Clips explicitly map complete drawings to the shared sixteen samples.
authoring.visual_approval: Pending user review; offline boards support review but do not activate live gameplay.
